sonnet.problem: Card 10 already asks about the LORD's command in 42:11 not to be afraid of the king of Babylon. Card 11 asks about the same command again with a made-up reason, so it re-asks the same fact.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The right answer is a place ("The land they're in now") and the two wrong answers are people ("The king of Babylon", "The prophet Jeremiah"). The answers are not the same kind of thing, so the right answer stands out.
sonnet.rule: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone.
